messages:
Jun (Design): quick design probe 

— thinking of a different preview: instead of chips/+N lists, what about a compact 'recipient timeline' that shows who will be notified in order (primary -> escalations) and marks suppressed entries inline. mock: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/recipient-timeline.png
Priya (Product): interesting. timeline could help people understand order of delivery and escalation paths. main asks: 1) must show provenance (which routing rule added it) 2) must clearly show suppression scope (route vs global).
Marco (Frontend): timeline is doable. UX-wise we'd show each recipient as a row with small timestamp-order bullet, a rule badge, and a suppressed state icon. collapsed timeline shows first 3 bullets then a single '+N recipients' expand control. expansion lazy-loads full breakdown.
Ellie (A11y): accessibility notes: timeline rows must be keyboard-traversable in linear order. when the timeline expands, announce summary: 'Expanded preview: 5 recipients, 1 suppressed' via aria-live. suppressed rows should be prefixed '(Suppressed)'. don't rely on color or icons alone.
Sam (SRE): backend support: include a field `delivery_order` and `scope` for suppression: {"route":"primary-route","global":false}. also include `masked_endpoint` boolean so UI can hide external emails/webhooks for users without perms. ticket INF-5999 opened.
Jun (Design): microcopy suggestion: change header from current 'Notify when threshold is met' to 'Trigger alert at threshold' — shorter, more action-oriented. Also propose a small 'Send preview' sandbox button that will deliver a staged alert to a configurable test endpoint so teams can validate mappings without spamming oncall.
Priya (Product): love the sandbox send. must be opt-in and rate-limited. show a confirmation modal that lists the exact resolved recipients that will receive the sandbox (and mask endpoints if needed).
Marco (Frontend): sample UI payload for dev story (compact):
```
preview: {
  totalRecipients: 5,
  recipients: [
    {order:1, endpoint:"slack:#alerts", rule:"primary-route", suppressed_by:null, masked:false},
    {order:2, endpoint:"pagerduty:infra", rule:"p90-escalation", suppressed_by:"maintenance-2024-08", masked:false},
    {order:3, endpoint:"email:ops@example.com", rule:"backup-route", suppressed_by:null, masked:true}
  ],
  suppressionSummary: "1 suppressed by maintenance-2024-08"
}
```
Ellie (A11y): sandbox send modal must be accessible: focus trap, announce recipients summary on open, and include a clear cancel button. when endpoints are masked, include an aria-describedby that explains why (permission required).
Sam (SRE): serverside will compute delivery_order by simulating routing and de-dup. we'll return a `mergedId` so UI can collapse identical endpoints. marked suppressed entries must include `scope: 'route'|'global'` and `reason`.
Jun (Design): decisions so far: 1) implement compact recipient timeline with delivery order bullets 2) show rule provenance and suppression scope inline (prefixed for SR users) 3) collapsed shows first 3 then '+N recipients' control (focusable, aria-expanded) 4) include optional 'Send preview' sandbox flow with mask+confirm and rate limit 5) header copy change to 'Trigger alert at threshold' 6) UI respects masked endpoints based on permission. owners: Jun (design), Marco (frontend), Sam (backend), Ellie (a11y).
Priya (Product): please add analytics event when sandbox send is used so we can monitor misuse. also add small tooltip on timeline bullets: '1st delivery action: routed by primary-route'.
ops-bot: figma updated https://figma.redwood.app/file/recipient-timeline/v1 (published to staging).
Jun (Design): I'll update figma with masked state and sandbox modal flows; Marco please add dev story + example payload, Sam link INF-5999, Ellie add a11y checklist. Will close after links are posted. :white_check_mark:
